mapper.sql: c.id, c.provider_account_code, pa.id AS provider_id, c.credential_type, c.auth_applier, c.encrypted_config, c.status
mapper.select: select from kb_provider_credentials c inner join kb_provider_accounts pa on c.provider_account_code = pa.code where pa.id = #{providerId} and c.status = 1 order by c.id desc limit 1
select from kb_provider_credentials c left join kb_provider_accounts pa on c.provider_account_code = pa.code where c.status = 1
mapper.insert: insert into kb_provider_credentials(provider_account_code, credential_type, auth_applier, encrypted_config, status) values(#{providerAccountCode}, #{credentialType}, #{authApplier}, #{encryptedConfig}, #{status})
mapper.update: update kb_provider_credentials c inner join kb_provider_accounts pa on c.provider_account_code = pa.code set c.status = 0, c.updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where pa.id = #{providerId} and c.status = 1
